profile.summary:
Software Engineer at Block specializing in Android and Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). Passionate about clean architecture, performant mobile apps, and product engineering.

Career Highlights:

Block: Building modern mobile experiences using Kotlin Multiplatform and building experiences for Bitcoin and applied cryptography.

Twitter: Engineered user-facing Android features and performance-driven ad formats at scale.

BabyCenter & Johnson & Johnson: Focused on collaborative feature delivery and empathy-driven user experience design.

Core Skills: Kotlin, Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), Android SDK, System Architecture, Bitcoin.
